description: The Classic tower-one with its star set to one (the towerone fixture with star edited to 1) sells Security and asks for a rating: the population clears the three-star bar but the Security gate holds it at two stars, a pass of one rung. Security is rebuilt and the tower runs three days; the hourly evaluation passes to three stars the moment the office opens, and the scripted evaluations after it, with the population short of the four-star bar, change nothing.
